sections.heading: Exit codes and remediation
sections.text: Exit 0 means this command completed its stated operation; source errors use 1, invalid usage or environment uses 2, and an internal failure uses 101. An emitted file is not runtime proof. Correct the diagnostic and retry; never execute a rejected or partially published artifact.
